title: Three years of PAT Scheme constitutes of 7 cycles (press release)

title: Greenhouse Gases Emission Intensity Target Rules, 2025 (draft, G.S.R. 234(E))
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
document_type: Draft rules (Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3(i))
notes: PRIMARY SOURCE TEXT retrieved and read directly in this session (mirrored copy of the Gazette of India Extraordinary notification; the official host is egazette.gov.in / moefcc.gov.in, not independently re-verified in this session). Issued under sections 3, 6 and 25 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, to operationalize the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, 2023. This is a DRAFT with a 60-day objection window from publication -- superseded by the final rules (see MOEFCC-GEI-FINAL-2025). Contains the full Schedule of named obligated entities (282 units across aluminium/cement/chlor-alkali/pulp & paper, 186 of them cement) with each entity's baseline (FY2023-24) GHG emission intensity and its compliance-year targets for FY2025-26 and FY2026-27. F. No. HSM-12/114/2022, signed Nameeta Prasad, Joint Secretary.

title: Measures to facilitate ease of doing business with respect to framework for assurance or assessment, ESG disclosures for value chain, and introduction of voluntary disclosure on green credits
authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
notes: Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/42. Amends SEBI-BRSR-CORE-2023: introduces 'assessment' as an alternative to 'assurance', narrows value-chain scope to partners individually >=2% of purchases/sales, and defers value-chain ESG disclosure by one FY. Primary sebi.gov.in text not directly fetched in this session; corroborated by multiple independent secondary summaries.
